Portfolio, credit, market and operational risk

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Aggregate without losing lineage
  • Trace limits and early warnings
  • Separate measurement from action authority

Technical flow

Every hand-off is a control boundary: on failure the flow holds, refers or denies — it never skips ahead.

  1. 01Reconciled exposures
  2. 02Risk measures
  3. 03Limits + stress
  4. 04Breach / EWS
  5. 05Committee action
  6. 06Monitoring evidence

1. Portfolio view

Exposure, concentration, vintage, delinquency, expected-loss and stress views derive from tenant-local accounts and approved classifications with drill-back lineage.

2. Limits and signals

Borrower/group, product, geography, partner, sector and funding limits run on defined measures and effective versions. Breach and early-warning signals create review or containment work.

3. Governed action

Risk appetite, overrides, provisioning, watchlists and remediation require named committees and evidence. Analytics or model scores inform action but do not silently mutate accounts or policy.
